title: clinopodium micranthum
intro: Clinopodium micranthum, commonly known as Brazilian pennyroyal, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and menstrual cramps, due to its health benefits, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium micranthum include pain relief, reducing inflammation, and inhibiting the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
